pl_new_on_day: Add a post on this day
pl_new_at_time: Add a post at this time
pl_dnd_hint: Drag to move · Alt/Option-drag to duplicate
pl_unscheduled_hint: Drag onto the calendar, or focus and press R. Dropping a calendar post here clears its time.
pl_drop_past: Posts can't be moved into the past.
pl_conflict: This post changed somewhere else. Load the latest version or overwrite it with your changes.
pl_locked_hint: This post is publishing or published; its content can't be changed.
pl_edit_invalidates: Approval is required: changing the content invalidates the approval and sends the post back to review.
pl_pick_accounts_hint: Pick the accounts to publish to ({platforms}).
pl_fb_native_hint: Facebook publishes the post itself, so it works while your computer is off.
pl_media_drop_hint: Drop files here or paste an image. JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, MP4, MOV.
pl_drop_unsupported: The dropped files couldn't be read.
pl_custom_first_comment: Custom first comment for this account
pl_best_times_unavailable: Best-time suggestions aren't available in this build yet.
pl_best_times_none: No suggestions for the next 7 days.
pl_preview_pick: Pick an account to see a preview.
pl_discard_text: This new post hasn't been saved yet. Discard it?
pl_publish_now_confirm: The post will be published to all selected accounts right away. Continue?
pl_approver_placeholder: e.g. client via email or WhatsApp
pl_need_time: Pick a date and time first.
pl_publishing_unavailable: Publishing isn't available in this build yet.
pl_publishing_unavailable_hint: You can still plan posts and run approvals; the queue appears here once the publishing engine is available.
pl_delete_scheduled_confirm: This post is scheduled. Deleting it cancels pending publishes (including ones scheduled on Facebook). Continue?
pl_reason_use_publishing: Use Schedule / Unschedule for this change.
pl_reason_transition_not_allowed: That step isn't allowed from the current status.
pl_reason_worker_only: Only the publisher can set this status.
pl_reason_same_status: The post already has this status.
pl_handed_off_hint: Scheduled on Facebook (publishes while your computer is off)
pl_list_empty_hint: Plan your first post with "New post".
pl_app_must_run: Instagram and Threads posts need MetaDash running (tray mode is enough).
pl_quota_tip: Publishing quota used in the last 24 hours
pl_missed_title: {n} posts were due while MetaDash wasn't running.
pl_approvals_hint: An approval pack is a single HTML/PDF file you can send to a client; apply their response code with "Import response". For approvals received by email or chat, use "Mark approved".
pl_pack_hint: {n} posts will be included. Internal notes are left out by default.
pl_pack_unavailable: Approval packs aren't available in this build yet.
pl_response_hint: The code is applied only to posts whose content hasn't changed since the pack; changed ones are listed as outdated.
pl_stale_hint: These posts changed after the pack was sent; send a new pack.
